assumptions: Quasi-static reed pressure/area law; stiffness not identified.
No piston timing in reed connection.
Open crankcase transfer endpoints; piston controls cylinder endpoints.
Partial-mixing displacement blend; fraction 0.5 unidentifed, not calibrated.
Common gamma/R, uniform cylinder temperature, synthetic FMEP 85000 Pa; no predictive validation.
